topics.concept: A model registry is the system of record for trained models: each entry stores artifacts, metrics, hyperparameters, and lineage back to the training data and code. Lifecycle stages like staging and production gate promotion, and immutable versioning makes every deployment reproducible. The simulator implements the full lifecycle on seeded training runs.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded training runs with metrics and artifacts, then exercises registration, staging, promotion, and deprecation transitions.
topics.name: Model Registry Tracker
topics.real_world_use: ML platforms track every production model through a central registry.

topics.concept: Experiment tracking logs every training run's parameters, metrics, and artifacts so results are comparable and reproducible. Run comparison views rank configs by metric, and tagging marks baselines and ablations. The simulator replays seeded runs into a searchable store with ranking queries.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded training runs over a hyperparameter grid with noisy metric outcomes and supports comparison and ranking queries.
topics.name: Experiment Tracker
topics.real_world_use: Research teams compare hundreds of runs to pick the best configuration.

topics.concept: A feature store serves consistent features to training and inference, eliminating the skew that comes from recomputing features differently in each path. Offline stores backfill training sets while online stores serve low-latency lookups, and point-in-time correctness prevents leaking future data into training. The simulator models both stores on seeded event streams.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded timestamped feature events and serves offline backfills and online lookups, checking training-serving parity.
topics.name: Feature Store Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Recommendation systems serve user features from online stores at millisecond latency.

topics.concept: Model versions pin an exact artifact plus its training context: data snapshot, code commit, and hyperparameters. Semantic-style versioning separates breaking changes from improvements, and aliases like champion point at the current production version. The manager resolves aliases and diffs version metadata.
topics.data_idea: Creates seeded version records with lineage metadata and resolves alias-to-version mappings across promotion events.
topics.name: Model Version Manager
topics.real_world_use: Deployment pipelines pin exact model versions for reproducible rollouts.

topics.concept: An inference server exposes models over a request API with batching, queueing, and worker pools: dynamic batching groups concurrent requests to raise GPU throughput, and timeouts protect tail latency. Health and readiness probes gate traffic during deploys. The simulator replays request traces through the queueing model.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes seeded request traces with arrival rates and token lengths, then simulates queueing, batching, and percentile latencies.
topics.name: Inference Server Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Every hosted model API runs on an inference server with batching and autoscaling.

topics.concept: Batch inference scores large datasets offline: sharded workers process chunks in parallel, checkpoints resume after failures, and output sinks collect predictions with row-level lineage. Throughput matters more than latency, so large batches are optimal. The pipeline partitions seeded datasets and tracks completion per shard.
topics.data_idea: Generates a seeded scoring dataset, partitions it into shards, and simulates worker throughput with failure injection and checkpoint resume.
topics.name: Batch Inference Pipeline
topics.real_world_use: Banks score millions of transactions nightly with batch inference jobs.

topics.concept: Canary deployment shifts a slice of traffic to the new model and watches guardrail metrics before proceeding: error rate, latency, and key business metrics must stay within bounds. Automated analysis promotes or rolls back based on statistical comparison with the stable version. The orchestrator steps traffic percentages on seeded metric streams.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded metric streams for stable and canary versions with an injected regression case, then steps traffic and reports the decision.
topics.name: Canary Deployment Orchestrator
topics.real_world_use: Model platforms canary every production model update before full rollout.

topics.concept: Blue-green deployment runs two full environments and flips a router from blue to green: instant cutover with instant rollback by flipping back. The green environment is validated with smoke tests and shadow traffic before the switch. The runner models both environments on seeded traffic with a failure-injection drill.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded traffic across blue and green environments, runs smoke checks, flips the router, and measures rollback time on injected failure.
topics.name: Blue-Green Deployment Runner
topics.real_world_use: API providers use blue-green flips for zero-downtime model swaps.

topics.concept: Data drift is when production inputs shift away from training data: feature distributions move, new categories appear, and model quality decays silently. Statistical tests like PSI and KS compare windows of live data against the reference. The detector computes drift scores per feature on seeded streams and raises alerts past thresholds.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded feature streams with injected distribution shifts and computes per-feature drift scores and alert timelines.
topics.name: Data Drift Detector
topics.real_world_use: Fraud models are monitored for drift as transaction patterns change.

topics.concept: Production model monitoring watches prediction quality, latency, and business outcomes on live traffic: prediction drift, confidence drops, and feedback loops all signal trouble. Alert rules combine statistical thresholds with minimum-sample guards to avoid noise. The monitor replays seeded production streams into dashboards and alert queues.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes seeded production prediction streams with an injected quality decay and evaluates alert precision and detection delay.
topics.name: Production Model Monitor
topics.real_world_use: Lending platforms monitor credit models for silent quality decay.

topics.concept: An ML pipeline orchestrator chains data validation, training, evaluation, and deployment into a versioned directed graph. Each step is cached by its inputs so unchanged steps skip reruns, and conditional branches route on eval metrics. The simulator executes seeded pipeline graphs with failure injection and retry policies.
topics.data_idea: Builds seeded pipeline DAGs with step durations and injects failures, then executes with caching and retries and reports run timelines.
topics.name: ML Pipeline Orchestrator
topics.real_world_use: Model teams run nightly retraining pipelines as orchestrated DAGs.

topics.concept: An artifact store holds every byproduct of ML work: trained weights, tokenizers, eval reports, and plots, each content-addressed so identical files deduplicate. Retention policies prune old artifacts while protecting production-pinned versions. The manager tracks lineage links between runs and their artifacts.
topics.data_idea: Creates seeded artifact records with hashes and lineage links, then applies retention policies and reports protected versus pruned sets.
topics.name: Artifact Store Manager
topics.real_world_use: Experiment platforms deduplicate model weights by content hash.

topics.concept: Hyperparameter sweeps search the config space: grid search is exhaustive but wasteful, random search covers more distinct values per dimension, and Bayesian optimization models the response surface. Schedulers run trials in parallel with early stopping for unpromising configs. The scheduler compares strategies on a seeded response surface.
topics.data_idea: Defines a seeded hyperparameter response surface and runs grid, random, and Bayesian trials, comparing best-found values per budget.
topics.name: Hyperparameter Sweep Scheduler
topics.real_world_use: AutoML services schedule thousands of tuning trials across GPU fleets.

topics.concept: Dataset versioning snapshots the exact rows and labels used to train each model: content hashes detect silent changes, and diff reports show added, removed, and relabeled rows between versions. Immutable snapshots make audits and reproductions possible. The manager versions seeded datasets and resolves model-to-data lineage.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded dataset versions with controlled row changes and produces diff reports plus lineage maps to model versions.
topics.name: Dataset Version Manager
topics.real_world_use: Regulated industries prove which data trained each deployed model.

topics.concept: Serving SLOs turn latency goals into measurable commitments: p99 under 500ms over rolling windows, with error budgets that burn when violations pile up. Burn-rate alerts fire fast on rapid degradation and slow on gradual drift. The monitor tracks seeded latency streams against the SLO and reports budget remaining.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded latency streams with injected degradation episodes and computes SLO compliance, burn rates, and alert firings.
topics.name: Serving Latency SLO Monitor
topics.real_world_use: Inference providers contract latency SLOs with enterprise customers.

topics.concept: Rollback returns production to the last known-good model version when a deploy degrades: the trigger can be an automated guardrail or a human decision, and traffic drains back while the incident is recorded. Rollback drills measure time-to-recovery so the path is proven before it is needed. The manager executes rollback on seeded incident timelines.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded deploy incidents with metric degradation and executes rollback, measuring detection plus recovery time.
topics.name: Model Rollback Manager
topics.real_world_use: On-call teams roll back bad model deploys within minutes using versioned artifacts.

topics.concept: ML audit trails record who trained what, on which data, with which code, and when it shipped: the full provenance chain for every production decision. Immutable append-only logs with signed entries resist tampering, and query tools answer who-did-what during incidents. The logger builds the chain from seeded run events.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded training and deploy events with actor identities and writes a tamper-evident chained log with query support.
topics.name: ML Audit Trail Logger
topics.real_world_use: Regulated lenders audit model provenance before every release.

topics.concept: Inference autoscalers add and remove serving replicas as request rate changes: target metrics like queue depth or GPU utilization drive scaling decisions, with cooldowns preventing flapping. Predictive scaling pre-warms capacity ahead of known peaks. The simulator replays seeded traffic patterns and measures cost versus SLO violations.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes seeded diurnal traffic patterns and simulates replica scaling, reporting cost and p99 latency per policy.
topics.name: Inference Autoscaler Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Cloud inference endpoints autoscale replicas to meet demand spikes.
